title: Vivekananda addresses the Parliament of the World's Religions
summary: The first World's Parliament of Religions opened in Chicago, where Swami Vivekananda's speech beginning Sisters and Brothers of America won wide acclaim.
reason: It was organized alongside the World's Columbian Exposition to bring together representatives of the world's faiths.
significance: It began formal interfaith dialogue and introduced Hinduism and Buddhism to a broad Western audience.
place: Art Institute of Chicago, Chicago, United States
